fee_notes: Base fee is $5,000. If authorized to sell medium-sized or larger pizzas, fee is $10,000-$20,000 depending on license term and licensed concept. Authorization determined by franchisor based on location relative to other Pizza Hut locations. Non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The initial license fee is specified in the applicable Schedule and is $5,000, unless you are authorized to offer medium-sized or larger pizzas, in which case the initial license fee is $10,000 to $20,000, depending on the license term and the Licensed Concept.
